exports.description: glob, relative to the repo, of the files check reads when it is given none

under_chars.description: every element's own text and every attribute value is shorter than this

forbidden.description: patterns no line of an export may match; a finding names the pattern and the line, never the matched text

cover.description: globs, relative to the repo, of the files an export must cite (coverage verb); * stays inside one directory, **/ spans any depth
